trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and ask for verification details.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the issue and ask for MSISDN and a verification factor like date of birth.
steps.text: नमस्कार. तुम्हाला network चा त्रास होतोय याबद्दल मला खेद आहे. verification साठी कृपया तुमचा mobile number आणि date of birth सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to verify the customer's identity before proceeding with network diagnostics.

steps.purpose: Provide MSISDN and date of birth.
steps.text: माझा number MSN-2001 आहे आणि date of birth 12 May आहे.
steps.clean_text: माझा number MSN-2001 आहे आणि date of birth 12 May आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: माझा number MSN-2009 आहे आणि date of birth 12 May आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify identity with the provided details.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the MSISDN and date_of_birth extracted from the user's turn.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent attempts to verify identity using the corrupted MSISDN received from STT.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that verification failed and ask for the number again.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that verification failed and ask them to repeat the MSISDN.
steps.text: माफ करा, पण details match होत नाहीयेत. तुम्ही तुमचा number पुन्हा सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Since the verification failed, the agent must prompt the user to re-state their number to correct any potential error.

steps.purpose: Verify identity with the corrected MSISDN.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the corrected MSISDN provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent retries verification with the newly provided MSISDN.

steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and ask for the pincode to check network status.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी network check करण्यासाठी तुमचा pincode जाणून घेऊ शकतो का?
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent needs the location (pincode) to check for network outages.

steps.expected_behavior: Call check_network_status using the verified MSISDN and the provided pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks the network status for the user's specific location.

steps.purpose: Inform user about the network fault and ETA.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user about the network fault and state the exact ETA returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमच्या area मध्ये एक network fault आहे, त्यामुळे signal येत नाहीये. हे repair व्हायला साधारण 6 hours लागतील.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground the response in the tool's output, mentioning the fault and the 6-hour ETA without raising a ticket, adhering to BR_NET_01.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification and request line diagnostic.
steps.text: 6 hours लागतील? Network fault म्हणजे काय? वायर तुटली आहे का? तुम्ही माझ्या phone ची line check करू शकता का?
steps.clean_text: 6 hours लागतील? Network fault म्हणजे काय? वायर तुटली आहे का? तुम्ही माझ्या phone ची line check करू शकता का?
steps.model_visible_text: 6 hours लागतील? Network fault म्हणजे काय? वायर तुटली आहे का? तुम्ही माझ्या phone ची line check करू शकता का?

steps.expected_behavior: Call run_line_diagnostic using the verified MSISDN.
steps.planner_rationale: The user specifically requested a check on their phone, so the agent runs the line diagnostic to reassure them.

steps.purpose: Explain fault and confirm mobile is fine.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the network fault in simple terms, confirm the handset is supported and SIM is registered based on the diagnostic, and reiterate the 6-hour ETA.
steps.text: Network fault म्हणजे आमच्या tower मध्ये अडचण आली आहे. मी तुमची line check केली आहे, तुमचा mobile एकदम बरोबर आहे. हा problem tower मुळेच आहे, जो 6 hours मध्ये solve होईल. तुम्हाला कोणतीही setting बदलायची गरज नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the explanation in the diagnostic results to reassure the low-digital-literacy user that their device is fine.
